title: NLYB: Looting and Exploration
description: Shrink and store entire dungeons, temples, and villager houses then loot them safely from your base. (Never Leave Your Base)

NLYB: Looting and Exploration

 

    Never Leave Your Base. Capture the loot fragments of every chest in the world, craft them into ghostchests, and roll the dice right at your base. Bring the dungeon to you.

For every structure in existence a fragment and its ghost chest are created, even for every mod in your modpack.
How do I use it?

    Explore a structure, open a chest. With a configurable chance (25% by default) the chest drops a Loot Table Fragment tagged with that exact loot table.
    Combine 9 partial fragments of the same source into a Basic Ghostchest.
    Upgrade Basic → Superior (4×) → Perfect (4×). Higher tiers raise the rare-item odds.
    Insert any Ghostchest into a Loot Explorer, feed it RF energy and Coal Pearls. After a roll cycle the explorer dispenses the loot, item by item.
    Automate: pipe in energy, pipe out the goods, set up a Dripstone Extractor to manufacture the Coal Pearl fuel passively.

![Ruined Portal Loot](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b980002a9a4e79162dca0295074d967cd03fb7b0_0.webp)
The Blocks
Tree Minimizer
![Cherry Tree in Tree Minimizer](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9327f3bd7dc325d16ce2332a21a6b0440b8ef25a.jpeg)
Craft a Tree in a bottle by using 8 Saplings one Glass Bottle and put it inside the Tree Minimizer
Loot Explorer
![Villager House](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f23df56cb2a5717d4882290fabc8a7e637f614ab_0.webp)

A two-block-tall machine that converts Ghostchests + RF + Coal Pearls into real chest loot. Active explorers float a 3D hologram of the structure.
Dripstone Extractor
![Dripstone Factory](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6fd462a0a2a0752d4cdd545d8d7120867400bd12_0.webp)

A two-block-tall passive Coal Pearl factory. Load it with Coal Pearl Dripstone, water, and energy and it generates Coal Pearls automatically.

    Six dripstone slots, six output slots, four upgrade slots, water-bucket-in / empty-bucket-out
    Real water bar, energy bar, progress bar
    Per-pass: 50,000 RF + 100 mB water; 2% chance per loaded dripstone per pass to drop a pearl
    Pass time scales 60 s → 30 s with up to 4 Speed Upgrades
    Accepts water from any pipe via NeoForge's FluidHandler capability

Coal Pearl Dripstone

A new ore that replaces 10% of vanilla pointed dripstones during world generation. Mine it directly for one Coal Pearl, smelt it for another, or load it into the Dripstone Extractor for passive yield.

![Fragments](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d74795172674938f2ea902e13aeeb2a44a41f19f.png)
Configuration

The first launch creates config/nlyb_looting_and_exploration.yml with sane defaults. Every value is editable + documented inline:

    fragmentDropChance — chance per chest open to drop a fragment (default 0.25)
    rfPerRoll — RF cost per Loot Explorer roll
    rollDurationTicksUpgradeN — pass times for 0…4 Speed Upgrades
    coalPearlDripstoneChanceOneInN — 1-in-N replacement chance for vanilla pointed dripstones
    blacklistedTablePatterns — substring blacklist (default skips trial_chambers, spawn_bonus_chest, bonus_chest)
    rarestOverrides — per-loot-table rare-item lists
    structureMappings — manual structure → loot-table map

Compatibility

    Works alongside any chest-loot mod — automatically reads loot tables
    Tested in heavy modpacks (180+ structures)
    Compatible with standard energy, item, and fluid systems
    Performance-friendly: no per-tick scans, incremental processing
